Left arm holds a clipboard close to the torso, with the clipboard angled slightly outward-left so the page feels readable. Right hand marks the top of the clipboard with a pen. Keep props minimal — clipboard as hero prop and pen as the only support prop. No stacks of boxes, no extra office clutter, no white cutout around the character.
